frictions.description: TipTap editor does not visually update when store state changes externally (import, Start Over). Content is correct in the store but the editor DOM shows stale content until the card is collapsed and re-expanded.
frictions.resolution: Workaround: collapse and re-expand the Newsletter card after import or Start Over to force editor re-mount. Root fix: the NewsletterEditor component needs to detect external store changes and update the TipTap editor content.

frictions.description: Position toggle buttons (Top/Bottom) are not accessible via agent-browser snapshot refs or find text commands. Had to use DOM evaluation to click them.
frictions.resolution: Used document.querySelector + click() via eval to interact with position buttons.

frictions.description: Import requires programmatically setting file input value and dispatching change event since the file input is hidden and agent-browser upload doesn't work on button elements.
frictions.resolution: Used eval to create File object, set it on the hidden input via DataTransfer, and dispatch change event.

frictions.description: Export file download captured via blob interception (overriding createElement and URL.createObjectURL) since agent-browser doesn't have a built-in download capture mechanism.
frictions.resolution: Set up JS interceptors before clicking Export to capture the blob content.

summary: Tested 19 assertions: 7 passed, 12 failed. The primary root cause for 12 failures is that generatePromotionEmailHTML() in src/lib/promotion-email-html.ts does not render the newsletter section in the email HTML template, despite accepting newsletterHeading, newsletterBody, and newsletterPosition in the PromotionEmailData interface. The newsletter card UI, store, export/import, persistence, status dot, toolbar icon, and Start Over all work correctly. The critical missing piece is the email HTML generation.
